payingUser: A facilities supervisor, venue operator, or worker who needs a quick documented phone-based noise observation.
paidUnit: One permanent unlock of unlimited timed microphone measurements, peak timelines, and PDF reports.
momentOfPayment: After a free live session demonstrates the meter, peak timeline, and report preview, at the first report export.
distinctnessSentence: Where the sound-meter shelf offers a live dB reading or a recording, this app turns a timed microphone sample into an explicitly indicative exposure verdict, annotated peak timeline, and device-labelled PDF report shared outside the app with no ads, account, renewal, or compliance claim.
day1RevenuePath: The listing targets the measured noise dosimeter shelf, lets the user complete a free live reading, then collects the one-time unlock through Play Billing when the report export is requested.

capabilities.note: Billing collects the single unlock. Ads are deliberately absent because ads and paywalls are measured complaints in the sampled pocket.

permissions: android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO for live local measurement; Play Billing's com.android.vending.BILLING; no account, location, storage, contacts, or background location permission.

archetypesRejected.revenueReason: Repeated reports are not a separate consumable product, so a second purchase would be artificial and cannibalise the unlock.
Ads are measured in 3 of 10 critical sampled reviews, so ad-led revenue copies a complaint the proposal is designed to remove.
The observed shelf is primarily free-to-install, with five of eight enriched listings declaring IAP, so an upfront listing price replaces a measured discovery funnel with an unmeasured one.
Subscription is banned by the owner's instruction and a local measurement/report tool has no recurring service cost to justify one.

assumptionsUnverified: A $4.99 one-time unlock will convert enough of a free-install audience; the only directly observed paid comparator costs $2.99.
The 15 percent Play service fee and 2 percent refund or tax reserve are planning assumptions rather than a reading of this developer account.
Phone microphone variability permits a clearly-labelled indicative workflow without making a misleading safety or compliance claim.
Leading incumbents do not already export the same peak-timeline PDF at an equal or lower one-time price.
